scope: Read-only static lifecycle review of frozen full-game seed-priority package and six r4 draft registrations.

findings.title: Worker receives source acceptance where preflight requires launch approval
findings.consequence: Worker treats independent source-acceptance document as launch approval and fails before runtime import/construction.

findings.title: Parent launch-approval gate schema conflicts across preflights
findings.trigger: One launch-approval file is supplied to observer and worker preflight.
findings.consequence: Exact dictionary checks require different gate-name sets; one preflight rejects any shared document.

findings.title: Terminal audit expects exit fields observer never writes
findings.trigger: Parent runs audit after an otherwise successful observer run.
findings.consequence: Audit raises `raw worker/observer exit differs` and rejects the completed run.

qualification_limits: Runtime manifest describes copied release binary and modified Python runtime; release parity is not qualified.
Evaluation contract says history BLOCKED, new cohort PENDING_NOT_RESERVED, and launch_authority false.
All six r4 registrations are inert drafts; no launch authority was present.
No tests, preflight, launch, Torch/MPS/native imports, or frozen-input mutations were performed.
